verdict.rationale: PostHog's self-host docs say it is open-source and "freely available for anyone to host themselves," with a free Docker Compose deployment under an MIT license, which covers the core of the story. An early community report said the production Dockerfile failed to create a database; that was a historical setup bug, not evidence that self-hosting doesn't work. Missing for 10: in-depth self-host docs (requirements, scaling, upgrades, support scope), clarity on which features are in the self-hosted build versus cloud-only, and recent independent hands-on corroboration of a working deployment.
